scope: Router, L2/L3/PoE shared wired engine; this is not a full IOS compatibility certification

referenceProfiles.routing: IOS XE 17.x public guides; exact 17.12 device observations separately unverified

repairs.finding: Physical switch service policies accepted configuration but bridged frames bypassed QoS
repairs.implementation: `engine.ts` applies physical ingress/egress policies to bridged IP frames on L2, L3 and PoE switches; actual selected EtherChannel members use the same hooks
repairs.behavioralEvidence: `tests/wired-fidelity.test.ts`: UDP succeeds before policy, fails on input/output drop, and recovers after removal; member marking changes received DSCP

repairs.finding: VLAN input marking did not affect bridged frames, and a physical hook could double-charge SVI traffic
repairs.implementation: Physical policy takes precedence over SVI marking; an ingress marker prevents a second logical input evaluation
repairs.behavioralEvidence: Same suite: actual received DSCP, exact per-port/VLAN counters, locally delivered SVI echo and fallback after removal

repairs.finding: Directly transmitted routed multicast/broadcast control messages bypassed output QoS
repairs.implementation: `sendControlDatagram` evaluates output policy before direct transmission
repairs.behavioralEvidence: Same suite: actual OSPF/EIGRP control drops expire peers and withdraw routes; unaffected connected ICMP still works; removal restores routed echo

repairs.finding: `match ip address ACL` was accepted but never matched in routing policy
repairs.implementation: `applyRouteMap` evaluates standard network and extended network/mask ACL semantics
repairs.behavioralEvidence: Same suite: actual BGP UPDATEs retain only permitted routes; standard/extended filters change real bidirectional UDP; removal restores advertisements

repairs.finding: VTPv1/v2 accepted equal revisions, did not increment local edits, excluded client-originated higher revisions and server adoption, copied extended VLANs, and retained stale revision when the payload was unchanged
repairs.implementation: Local server database edits advance revisions; strictly newer matching databases can be adopted from server/client peers; normal-range synchronization preserves local extended entries; unchanged payload still advances the received revision
repairs.behavioralEvidence: Same suite: both protocol versions, CLI VLAN rename/delete, higher client revision, equal-revision conflict, extended VLAN isolation, real VLAN UDP delivery and failure after deletion

repairs.finding: Routed EtherChannel compared local VRF names across peers
repairs.implementation: Channel negotiation ignores peer VRF names while still checking local member consistency
repairs.behavioralEvidence: Same suite: BLUE/RED locally named routed LACP groups establish and carry UDP; wrong local VRF fails

repairs.finding: Routed channel members processed ARP as both individual interfaces and the aggregate, producing competing member MAC replies
repairs.implementation: Routed bundle ingress is delivered to its logical aggregate
repairs.behavioralEvidence: Same suite and existing `core.test.ts` routed hashing tests: correct neighbor resolution, bidirectional flow and member hashing

repairs.finding: IPv6 BGP AF and UPDATE attributes were unsupported
repairs.implementation: Independent IPv4/IPv6 AF configuration and activation, negotiated logical capabilities, native IPv6 TCP transport, family-specific NLRI/next-hop validation, shared transport, policy, show output, rendering and VRF-Lite
repairs.behavioralEvidence: `tests/bgp-multiprotocol.test.ts`: native IPv6 TCP data, ND and UDP; family filtering; actual withdrawals; activation removal; config replay/reload; overlapping BLUE/RED neighbor and prefix isolation

repairs.finding: BGP `maximum-paths` was accepted but installed only one route; IGP cost was omitted from path ordering
repairs.implementation: Eligible eBGP/iBGP equal paths install actual ECMP; real IGP next-hop cost precedes router ID and limits multipath eligibility
repairs.behavioralEvidence: Same suite: 60 delivered UDP flows use both installed next hops; link failure leaves one working path; OSPF cost chooses the higher-router-ID peer with the shorter IGP path

repairs.finding: IPv4 and IPv6 prefix lists shared one destructive sequence namespace and rendered IPv6 entries as IPv4
repairs.implementation: A compatible combined store keeps independent per-family sequence, removal and auto-numbering behavior; render/show commands select the correct family
repairs.behavioralEvidence: Same suite: identical list name and sequence filter different AFs, independent removal and replay

repairs.finding: Dual-stack BFD deduplicated interfaces across address families; IPv6 BGP could not associate a global peer with its link-local BFD session
repairs.implementation: Independent IPv4/IPv6 sessions; global IPv6 peers bind to the actual on-link neighbor's link-local BFD session
repairs.behavioralEvidence: Same suite: real BFD control loss withdraws IPv6 BGP before its hold timer while connected IPv6 ICMP remains operational; restoring control packets restores routed UDP

repairs.finding: A newly operational routed EtherChannel could have no connected route until an unrelated later recompute; a down unused member could suspend an otherwise compatible group
repairs.implementation: Operational link/trunk/VTP/channel state is prepared before connected routes; later control reconciliation remains; local operational member checks exclude physically down members
repairs.behavioralEvidence: `tests/ethernet-physical.test.ts`: first one-member bundle installs its connected route immediately, carries real ICMP, withdraws on disconnect and restores on reconnect; VTP revision tests verify no duplicate increments

repairs.finding: Fixed speed mismatch kept carrier up, automatic/explicit 1000 Mb/s could not persist independently, and duplex had no traffic effect
repairs.implementation: Copper negotiation determines carrier, actual speed and duplex; real opposing transmission overlap causes half-side collision/late-collision, full-side CRC, and actual frame loss; operational speed feeds routing/STP/default bandwidth and storm-control measurements
repairs.behavioralEvidence: `tests/ethernet-physical.test.ts`: carrier/connected-route withdrawal and recovery, config replay, parallel detection, exact error direction, mismatch correction, matched half-duplex arbitration and actual OSPF metric/ICMP, negotiated LACP compatibility, shared RSTP timing and packet-delivered CDP diagnostics

repairs.finding: Queue reservations, priority, shaping and queue-limit were accepted without scheduling effects
repairs.implementation: Physical output policies use actual event-clock class queues, byte-weighted fair scheduling, congestion-limited LLQ, average-rate shaping and tail drop; pre-mark classification survives egress marking; admission and dequeue counters are separate
repairs.behavioralEvidence: `tests/qos-scheduler.test.ts`: unequal-size 25/75 byte shares, priority ordering, exact delivered/drop counts, measured shaping spacing, priority exceed drops, removal/flush/recovery, L2/L3/PoE bridging, Catalyst relative-weight semantics/limits and fail-closed unsupported import

repairs.finding: EIGRP IPv4 auto-summary was accepted but stored only; implicit summary metric was zero
repairs.implementation: Classic router and named IPv4 topology commands now suppress classful-boundary specifics, create conditional fixed-AD5 Null0 routes and choose minimum live component metrics. External-only routes stay specific until an internal component enables aggregation. IPv6 rejects classful summarization.
repairs.behavioralEvidence: Six independent tests in tests/eigrp-auto-summary.test.ts cover real echo failure/recovery and external server traffic, component metric/withdrawal, VRF, topology/protocol output, help, no/default, replay and reload.

repairs.finding: Value-bearing QoS no forms rejected; removing violate-action could collapse three-color metering and forward violations under exceed/transmit
repairs.implementation: Validate DSCP/action arguments before reset; retain persisted three-color mode independently of an explicit violate action, with default drop, operational counters, excess burst rendering and old violate/Be compatibility.
repairs.behavioralEvidence: Three added qos-parity cases use actual echo marking/drops, help, malformed-input atomicity, legacy mode data, CLI replay and save/reload.

repairs.finding: Classic and named EIGRP per-interface BFD flags were omitted from rendered configuration
repairs.implementation: Render classic bfd interface or named per-AF af-interface blocks with true/false BFD settings scoped to the matching local VRF.
repairs.behavioralEvidence: Three eigrp-bfd-persistence cases: classic IPv4 and named IPv6 router/AF/af-interface, enable/no/default, real route/echo gating, rendering/copy and save/reload.

repairs.finding: Normal EIGRP route vectors were computed across remote topology instead of learned from delivered UPDATEs
repairs.implementation: IPv4/IPv6 per-neighbor INIT/UPDATE/ACK transport with ordered delta/withdrawal, duplicate/stale suppression, restart refresh, retry reset and valid-packet hold refresh now drives received vectors and the local DUAL/RIB; transit advertisements use local selected routes.
repairs.behavioralEvidence: 14 independent tests/eigrp-updates.test.ts cases cover classic/named AFs, UPDATE/ACK loss, queued withdrawal, stale sequence/session replay, retry exhaustion, hold, ACL, restart, transit policy/no-form and actual echo. Existing DUAL/SIA/summary/VRF/metric tests pass.

repairs.finding: Router policy-class fair-queue/random-detect remained explicitly unsupported despite target curriculum congestion scope
repairs.implementation: 16 hashed byte-fair FIFO flow buckets, per-bucket capacity, actual EWMA precedence/DSCP early/max WRED drops and IPv4/IPv6 ECN marking. Router grammar/help/reset/render/replay and per-flow/per-curve counters are connected to actual egress admission/dequeues. Catalyst/priority/placement and unsupported modes reject.
repairs.behavioralEvidence: 14 independent tests/qos-congestion.test.ts cases cover greedy/small flow protection, unequal-size byte fairness/FIFO, per-flow tail isolation, DSCP preferential drops, IPv4/IPv6 ECT/CE/hard-drop, no/default, replay/reload, atomic invalid input, legacy imports and ping ToS.

subsystems.operationalTrace: Negotiated carrier/speed/duplex → actual serialization and traffic-driven errors; VLAN/STP/security admission → MAC learning → SVI routing; physical/core/switching/PoE/wired regressions
subsystems.limits: Bounded copper model. No FLP/master-slave signal exchange, binary exponential backoff, PHY waveform, calibrated attenuation, cable length/pinout faults or fiber transceivers. Matching half duplex uses deterministic shared-medium arbitration. No finite hardware MAC/TCAM resource model; tagged aggregate subinterfaces are not covered by the routed bundle test

subsystems.operationalTrace: Per-VLAN roles/costs and transition timers; actual heartbeat loss for loop guard; topology/compatibility tests
subsystems.limits: Computed root/role election; no complete received-BPDU election/proposal/agreement or CIST region-boundary FSM; UplinkFast lacks MAC-update packets

subsystems.operationalTrace: Negotiated trunk state → domain/revision database adoption → actual VLAN forwarding
subsystems.limits: Computed rather than packet FSM; VTPv3 primary-server behavior and VTP pruning absent; transparent version-specific advertisement handling not exhaustively validated

subsystems.operationalTrace: Local/peer compatibility → active/standby members → actual single-member frame/hash forwarding
subsystems.limits: Computed negotiation, no wire PDUs; no independent member congestion scheduler; asymmetric peer allowed-VLAN/native-VLAN consistency has not been certified against the selected platform

subsystems.operationalTrace: Connected/static RIB → recursive weighted forwarding paths → ARP/ND → actual packets; resolver/reference/VRF suites
subsystems.limits: Original deterministic hashing, not a hardware ASIC reproduction; bounded recursion. Control-plane consumers outside BGP still contain a separate `resolveEgress` helper and need further edge-case parity review

subsystems.operationalTrace: Actual Hello/DBD/LSREQ/LSUPDATE/LSACK and received LSDB → SPF/RIB; loss, timers, AF, NSSA and virtual-link tests
subsystems.limits: Logical router records, not full area-scoped RFC LSA-type databases. DR election and area adapters are computed; complete NBMA/wait and NSSA translator/P-bit/forwarding-address FSMs absent

subsystems.operationalTrace: Delivered Hello/INIT/UPDATE/ACK received vectors drive local topology/RIB and transit advertisement; actual QUERY/REPLY/SIA gates DUAL. Summaries, local policy, metric/variance/stub, VRF and BFD retain actual traffic tests.
subsystems.limits: Logical stop-and-wait UPDATE and separate DUAL transactions, fixed retries, computed discovery/auth eligibility, no binary TLVs/adaptive RTO/conditional-receive multicast/unified complete DUAL matrix/control bandwidth pacing; bounded safe-number metrics and external scalar seeds.

subsystems.operationalTrace: Actual periodic/triggered advertisements, policies, poison/aging and RIB; loss/version/timer tests
subsystems.limits: Single selected route, no ECMP or full request-response exchange; queue/flash threshold knobs are stored only

subsystems.operationalTrace: Actual persistent TCP and negotiated IPv4/IPv6 unicast → received Adj-RIB-In → policy/best path/ECMP → RIB/UPDATEs
subsystems.limits: Logical MP capability/UPDATE envelopes. Capability changes reset the session. No binary encoding, MRAI, graceful restart, confederations, VPN/multicast SAFIs or full collision/event matrix. Explicit IPv6 link-local neighbor zone syntax and extended next-hop capability are unsupported. The 65-second reboot regression follows existing keepalive/retry detection; complete simultaneous-open behavior remains simplified

subsystems.operationalTrace: Address-family-aware prefix policy, standard/extended routing ACLs, ordered deny/set/continue, PBR next-hop selection; policy/redistribution tests
subsystems.limits: Bounded IOS policy language. Repeated same-category match command merging, bare removal forms and all unsupported match/set combinations still need explicit per-command reconciliation

subsystems.operationalTrace: Ingress ACL → inbound NAT → local/control delivery or route/PBR → outbound NAT/QoS/ACL → wire; policy/core suites
subsystems.limits: Modeled packet fields and bounded NAT/PBR catalog; no full IOS ACL/message set, NAT ALG or exhaustive noninitial-fragment hardware behavior

subsystems.operationalTrace: Actual ingress DHCP/ARP/ND/IP → binding/rate/guard policy → permit/drop and counters
subsystems.limits: Structured fields, not raw packet-byte validation or every platform hardware feature; resource/attack behavior is bounded

subsystems.operationalTrace: Actual classification, marking/policing, physical/L3/control drops; physical output CBWFQ/LLQ/shaper queues with real delivery timing and congestion counters; router 16-flow queues and actual precedence/DSCP WRED/ECN admission/dequeue/header counters
subsystems.limits: Bounded byte-weighted scheduler, not a Cisco ASIC recreation. Physical Ethernet output only, one priority class, maximum 64 router classes/eight Catalyst queues including class-default, queue-limit 1–4096 and aggregate safety limit 16,384 queued frames. Shapers allow one initial packet, meter IP bytes, and do not implement IOS burst/overhead/hierarchy options. LLQ uses a documented simulator 200 ms token allowance (minimum 1500 bytes), active under congestion. Catalyst mixed bandwidth types and bandwidth+shape conflict reject; remaining-percent weights may total above 100. Router fixed 16-flow fair-queue and actual EWMA precedence/DSCP WRED/ECN are operational. Default curves, linear probability, idle decay and finish-tag scheduling are teaching approximations, not hardware-certified. Catalyst router syntax, priority flow/WRED, byte/time/discard-class options and input/CoPP/logical queues reject. Older imported unsupported policies retain their configuration but fail closed with explicit diagnostics; CLI replay must remove/replace them

subsystems.operationalTrace: Actual advertisements/hold expiry → per-observer election → ARP/MAC gateway ownership → routed traffic
subsystems.limits: IPv4 model; no complete Coup/Resign, GLBP redirect/secondary-forwarder timers or IPv6 FHRP; auth compatibility is not cryptographic

subsystems.operationalTrace: Actual link/IP controls, advertised timers and optional echo → dependency failure/err-disable; control/routing/BGP tests
subsystems.limits: Single-hop bounded state model; BFD authentication/dampening templates are stored only; demand/multihop and complete diagnostics absent

subsystems.operationalTrace: Independent underlay resolution → actual logical registration/resolution → GRE inner/outer forwarding
subsystems.limits: No DMVPN Phase 3 redirect/shortcut FSM, NHS clustering or IPv6 NHRP; stored shortcut/redirect flags do not implement them

subsystems.operationalTrace: Actual IGMP/PIM Register/dense controls and data; computed shared trees/DR; persistent TCP MSDP
subsystems.limits: Computed Hello/Join-Prune/Assert eligibility; no complete BSR/Auto-RP, IGMP exclude matrix, IPv6 multicast/MLD or full MSDP mesh/filter catalog

subsystems.operationalTrace: Actual copied frames and routed structured exports; counters follow observed packets
subsystems.limits: Logical envelopes, no wire-compatible RSPAN/ERSPAN/NetFlow encoding or arbitrary flexible record fields

subsystems.operationalTrace: Actual ICMP/HTTP/UDP probes and timed object state consumed by FHRP/routes; key validity windows gate control packets
subsystems.limits: Bounded operation/track catalog; no cryptographic protocol digests. PTP election reports `synchronized=false`, not clock synchronization

subsystems.operationalTrace: Direct enabled PSE port + budget and high/low port priority → detection-order allocation → AP power lifecycle and real client loss/recovery; PoE/wireless tests
subsystems.limits: One full-feature 30 W AP allocation with high/low priority and equal-priority detection order. No 802.3af reduced mode, 802.3bt, calibrated electrical faults or non-AP powered devices

limitations: All subsystem rows remain partial; command inventory status must not be inferred from passing a subsystem regression.

fullRegression.note: Concurrent accounting work; no wired/BGP/physical/queue/discovery/wireless failure in this run. This record is a snapshot, not the final repository acceptance result.

eigrpFocusedRegression.note: Control-plane/routing/VRF/policy/reference/core/wired/BGP focused run; topology-display addition subsequently rechecked independently. Parent owns final combined acceptance.

eigrpAutoSummaryRegression.note: Includes final local Null0 topology display assertions for classic and named IPv4.

qosNegationAndBfdRegression.note: QoS policer/scheduler, EIGRP auto-summary/BFD, control-plane CLI, routing VRF, show and CLI syntax suites. Typecheck passed. Parent owns final combined acceptance.

eigrpDeliveredUpdateRegression.note: Bounded routed/control/core/VRF/policy/show/wired/BGP regression; parent owns final all-node acceptance.

qosCongestionRegression.note: Congestion/scheduler/policer/wired/physical/CLI/help/show/control-plane/reference-policy suites. Parent owns final all-node acceptance.

negationSemanticsBoundary: Supplied QoS DSCP/action arguments are validated then reset the single modeled setting; native behavior for valid arguments differing from current configuration is unverified. Named EIGRP standalone autonomous-system remains rejected by selected-reference grammar.
